summary.text: Natasha Hill is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 3-Position 1 since January 13, 2025, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney, licensed broker and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Hill earned a high school diploma from Rogers High School in 2000, an associate degree from Spokane Community College in 2001, a bachelor's degree in sociology from the University of Washington in 2003 and a law degree from Southwestern Law School in Los Angeles in 2006.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey from an earlier campaign, she described herself as a fourth-generation Eastern Washingtonian from Spokane's Hillyard neighborhood who was raising her children and running her practice there.
